The finite tests are not used in place of infinite-parameter proof.

originality.rationale: Lin et al. already derived the three-mode effective matrix, the EP3 point and qualitative plotted EP2 curves. Those statements are expressly excluded from novelty. The analyzed increment is an exact global iff interval for varying bath coupling at fixed coherent coupling, the complete endpoint count, and its exact 3/2 cusp closing-width constant. Peřina et al. address general bosonic methods but explicitly calculate a different two-mode damping/amplification model. Independent equivalent derivations of the primary matrix discriminant remain a residual risk.
residual_risks: An analytically equivalent reduction of the primary 2024 spectral plot may appear in unindexed supplements or other literature.
The leading cusp exponent is a familiar cubic-catastrophe feature; originality rests on the exact model-specific global iff domain and coefficient rather than the general exponent.
The result concerns the amplitude matrix and does not transfer automatically to the full non-Markovian Liouvillian dynamics.

value.rationale: The exact nonoscillatory bath-coupling interval answers a physical parameter-selection question across the entire positive parameter domain. The pair of EP2 boundaries, their extinction threshold at the known EP3, and the sharp 3/2 width coefficient determine a nontrivial reservoir-tuning window. This is substantive model-specific spectral geometry, not a recomputation of the already-known EP3 or a claim of novel cubic-discriminant mathematics.
